official.application_cycle: 2027 call - fellowship start 1 October or 1 November 2027
official.status_note: The FWO lists the call as open: the 2027 call opened on 17 September 2026 and the last application date is 16 November 2026 at 5pm.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official call page publishes no tuition element: the award is a gross monthly salary plus an annual bench fee, not a fee-paying degree scholarship.
benefits: Gross monthly salary junior postdoctoral fellowship (4 years seniority): EUR 5,616.81 (index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Bench fee which can range from EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year
An employment contract for a term of three years with the FWO

Full reimbursement of the cost of the travel card for commuting to and from work by public transport (train - tram - bus - metro); for staff living abroad only travel costs up to the border are reimbursed
Bike allowance per kilometre for bike commuting (conditions in the postdoc regulations)
Extra bench fees possible in association with e.g. the Suzanne Duchesne Fund (EUR 50,000 for the 2027 call for oncology research submitted to the Med4 panel)
eligibility: Hold a PhD by thesis or a degree, diploma or certificate recognized as equivalent in accordance with European Union directives or a bilateral agreement

PhD awarded no longer than 3 years before 1 October of the year in which the fellowship starts, or PhD/defence obtained by 15 September of that year at the latest, with the public defence date notified to the FWO by 1 July of that year

Be affiliated with at least one principal Flemish host institution (e.g. a Flemish university, the Maritime Academy, Vlerick Business School or Antwerp Management School for management sciences, the Institute of Tropical Medicine, the Orpheus Institute, or a Flemish school of arts recognised by decree)
Have a supervisor at the Flemish host institution who submits a letter of recommendation
Not have previously benefited from a junior postdoctoral fellowship, not even partially

Submit a maximum of one application per call and a maximum of two applications for the same fellowship; from the 2027 call a second application is only possible if the first application was among the top 50% in the preselection
Agree to the FWO Research Integrity Clause
Note for supervisors: a supervisor may support no more than five candidates per call across the junior and senior postdoctoral programmes taken together
requirements: Candidates must submit and defend their application in English for the purposes of the international peer review
Application submitted via the FWO online application (e-portal at fwoweb.fwo.be), addressed to the FWO expert panel that best matches the project scope
Mandatory letter of recommendation from the supervisor, following the FWO guidelines; it is a mandatory component and an evaluation criterion
Agreement to the FWO Research Integrity Clause
documents: Online application form completed in the FWO e-portal (example application form with screenshots is published by the FWO)
Mandatory supervisor letter of recommendation (FWO advice form for postdoc fellowships)
Research proposal/project template completed within the online application
Any supporting documents for recognition of extra scientific seniority (sworn declaration to FWO personnel department within 6 months of start, if higher seniority than 4 years is to be recognised)
selection_criteria: Two-round evaluation by the FWO expert panel: online preselection meetings (18-25 March 2027), then (physical) interviews for candidates invited on 26 March 2027 (14 April - 5 May 2027)
The supervisor's letter of recommendation is taken into account as an evaluation criterion in the scoring grid
The board makes the final decision on the basis of the proposals from the expert panels; results are announced on 13 May 2027
Applications judged by the panel to fall outside the panel's scope may be rejected; the applicant is responsible for matching the application to the correct panel
coverage: Gross monthly salary of EUR 5,616.81 (junior postdoctoral researcher with 4 years of seniority, index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026)
Bench fee of EUR 4,000 to EUR 10,000 per year (fixed operating allowance)
Commuting costs: full reimbursement of the public transport commuting card, plus a bike allowance per kilometre
application_method: Secure a supervisor at a principal Flemish host institution and coordinate early, because a supervisor can support at most five junior and senior postdoc applications combined per call
Choose the FWO expert panel whose scope best fits the project before starting the form
Submit the application in English via the FWO e-portal (fwoweb.fwo.be) before the deadline of 16 November 2026 at 5pm
Ensure the supervisor submits the mandatory letter of recommendation
Optionally attend an FWO information session (registration through the research coordination office of the host institution)
official.application_route: Online application through the FWO e-portal (fwoweb.fwo.be), addressed to an FWO expert panel, with a mandatory supervisor letter of recommendation.
official.study_mode: Full-time (three-year employment contract; part-time appointments only within the limits set by the regulations)
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship or residency restriction is published. The candidate must be affiliated with a principal Flemish host institution; candidates with a PhD from a university outside the Flemish Community are assumed to have sufficient knowledge of Dutch for integration into the research environment.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - no nationality restriction is published; the application must be submitted and defended in English in view of the international peer review, and the candidate must hold a supervisor position at a Flemish host institution.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The application must be submitted to the FWO expert panel that best matches the project scope; panel-specific bench fees exist (e.g. the Suzanne Duchesne Fund bench fee is reserved for oncology research submitted to the Med4 panel, and Plantentuin Meise, VITO and Flanders Hydraulics fund fellowships in association with the FWO).
official.research_requirement: The application centres on the candidate's own research proposal, carried out under a supervisor at the Flemish host institution; fellows must submit an interim report after one year and an ex-post report at the end of the fellowship.
official.duration: 3 years, no extension possible; start on 1 October or 1 November 2027
official.description: The junior postdoctoral fellowship supports researchers who have recently obtained a doctoral degree to further specialise in their research discipline: the postdoctoral researcher develops their own research line while acquiring additional academic skills through training and mobility, so that the FWO gives young researchers optimal opportunities to build an independent international research career, in or beyond academia.
official.program_type: Government research council fellowship (postdoctoral, Research Foundation Flanders - FWO)

not_confirmed: english_requirement: no IELTS/TOEFL score or medium-of-instruction rule is published; the regulations only require that the application be submitted and defended in English
tuition_coverage: the official pages publish no tuition element for this salaried fellowship
verification.notes: Salary (EUR 5,616.81 gross/month, index 2.1647 on 1 March 2026), bench fee (EUR 4,000-10,000/year), deadline (16 November 2026, 5pm), 3-year duration and evaluation calendar were taken from the official FWO call page; eligibility articles, the three-year employment contract, the English-language application rule and the commuting travel/bike reimbursements come from the official FWO postdoctoral fellowship regulations.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a three-year salaried research position rather than a fee scholarship: you are employed by the FWO at a Flemish host institution, earning EUR 5,616.81 gross per month plus an annual bench fee of EUR 4,000-10,000 for research costs. The 2027 round opened on 17 September 2026 and closes hard on 16 November 2026 at 5pm via the FWO e-portal, with preselection in March 2027, in-person interviews in April-May 2027, results on 13 May 2027 and starts on 1 October or 1 November 2027. Your score depends heavily on the project and on your supervisor's mandatory recommendation letter, so lock in the supervisor and panel choice months before the deadline.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Researchers whose PhD was awarded from 1 October 2024 onwards (or whose defence is set for shortly before 15 September 2027) and who want a salaried three-year independent research career at a Flemish university or Flemish research institute.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your PhD date falls within the 3-year window for a 2027 start (awarded no earlier than 1 October 2024); if the defence is still pending, it must be held by 15 September 2027 and the date reported to the FWO by 1 July 2027
Select the expert panel by its published scope before drafting, and have the supervisor check the match
Agree with the supervisor early on the content of the mandatory recommendation letter using the FWO postdoc advice form
Draft the project in English and leave time for the supervisor's letter well before the 16 November 2026, 5pm e-portal deadline
Register in the FWO e-portal in advance and use the published example application form to see the field structure
common_rejection_risks: Panel mismatch: the panel can reject an application it judges out of scope, and the applicant carries that risk
Weak or missing supervisor letter: from this call the letter is mandatory and scored, and it must show supervisor commitment, expertise and infrastructure
A repeat application without first ranking in the top 50% of preselection is barred from the 2027 call onwards
Applications for candidates whose PhD falls outside the 3-year window are ineligible
If a supervisor backs more than five junior/senior candidates in one call, the excess application is inadmissible and the supervisor is barred from FWO funding for a year
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: No relocation allowance or housing support is published: budget visa/residence formalities, travel to interviews, housing and moving costs yourself, and treat the bench fee (EUR 4,000-10,000/year) as the envelope for research costs, with commuting covered separately and conference travel normally met from the bench fee or separate FWO travel grants.
document_audit: Use the dedicated FWO advice form for the supervisor letter - a generic reference letter risks scoring poorly because the letter is a scored criterion
Check the published example application form and project template before drafting so the e-portal fields are filled exactly as expected
If you claim more than 4 years of seniority, the sworn declaration with supporting documents must reach FWO personnel within 6 months of the fellowship start
Everything, including the interview defence, must be in English - no translated documents or local-language CVs
alerts: Deadline is a hard system cut-off: 16 November 2026 at 5pm, so do not rely on supervisor letters landing on the last day
Interviews are physical, so plan travel to Belgium for 14 April - 5 May 2027 if shortlisted

The Suzanne Duchesne Fund adds EUR 50,000 in special bench fees for the 2027 call but only for oncology research submitted to the Med4 panel, while the L'Oreal-UNESCO EUR 20,000 grant is not part of this call (next edition 2028)
The fellowship is an employment contract with duties capped at 8 hours per week, and cannot be combined with other remunerated activities except as listed in the regulations
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit in English through the FWO e-portal before 16 November 2026 (5pm) with the supervisor's letter; the expert panel preselects in March 2027, shortlisted candidates are interviewed in person in April-May 2027, and the FWO board decides based on panel proposals, with results announced on 13 May 2027.
